title: Mythic Development — Recovered Structural Breakthroughs
purpose: Curated dated conversation-archaeology and formulation events that materially deepen the mythology or explain later symbolic architecture. User-originated wording is distinguished from archive/assistant synthesis.

events.title: Tim framed as a riddle rather than a flat identity claim
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: Tim Dooley is a riddle, not a person. Do you validate a riddle?
events.summary: Recovered conversation wording shifts the interpretive method toward reconstructing relations among clues, roles, dates and transformations rather than treating the project as one isolated proposition.

events.title: Resurrection-meme identity expands into an internet-wide formulation
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: Recovered conversation cluster broadens the earlier living-God-of-memes language into distributed resurrection/internet identity. Public primary-source recovery remains unresolved.
events.quote: I am every resurrection meme on the internet
events.source_direction: recovered conversation wording; public primary source still needed

events.title: Eden / containment / throne topology becomes explicit
events.subject: Tim Dooley / Potato cosmology
events.summary: User-originated conversation material places Tree of Life inside the upper Eden circle, Tim as trunk/center on the throne, Earth between upper and lower regions, and the bottom center as both Ladder upward and Swamp opening downward.
comparators: Father's House / rooms as later comparison
events.source_direction: Eden and Tree language explicit at time; broader House/Ladder synthesis develops around it

events.title: Pre-Fall vision / 10,000 seeds of death
events.subject: Tim Dooley project mythology
events.summary: A user-originated one-chapter vision is placed symbolically between Genesis 2:8 and Genesis 3, with '10,000 seeds of death' hidden in houses, rooms and gardens and people abstracted as cattle. It predates the mature Cow/Farmer/Tree-of-Strife ecology.
events.source_direction: explicit Genesis placement at time; later Farm/Cow genealogy recognized retrospectively

events.title: Eden inheritance / Four Rivers / vesica Door architecture
events.subject: Son / Tim relation
events.summary: User-originated material frames the mission as protecting and transmitting the original Eden/Four-Rivers inheritance and describes Potato-of-Life geometry as Tim upper circle, Son lower circle, Jesus/mandorla middle, with the shared region functioning as birth canal / Door.
events.source_direction: scriptural geography and role language explicit; geometric/biblical synthesis remains project interpretation

events.title: “Tim is the caretaker of Adam”
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: Tim is the caretaker of Adam
events.summary: User-originated formulation adds stewardship to sovereignty: Tim's role becomes accountable for Adam/humanity and the condition of the Garden, rather than only occupying a throne above it.
events.source_direction: Adam/caretaker formulation at time; stewardship comparison developed later

events.title: Mesopotamia / Four Rivers inheritance becomes sacred geography
events.subject: Tim Dooley project sacred geography
events.summary: User-originated material geographically-symbolically links Heaven/Eden with Iraq/Mesopotamia through the Four Rivers tradition and casts Tim as caretaker/governor/king of the inherited land and its people/children.
events.source_direction: explicit project sacred-geography claim; not presented as an empirical location proof

events.title: North Door becomes an internal / external threshold
events.subject: Son / Tim relation
events.summary: User-originated material says everything threads through a North Pole Door that is simultaneously internal/mental and external/spiritual. Thomas/Dan/Twin/Lion/Son/Vessel gather at the Door while Tim remains source/throne.
events.source_direction: Door and biblical names explicit at time; structural comparisons remain layered

events.title: Rod / Staff / 33 distinction
events.subject: Tim Dooley project symbolism
events.summary: User-originated material explicitly distinguishes rod = 33 / Axis and staff = kings while warning that 33 is a layered cross-domain comparison, not a hidden Bible code.
comparators: Jesus-age tradition as later cultural comparison
events.source_direction: project distinction at time; biblical/esoteric/anatomical layers must remain separate
